overview.en: Parliament consists of the Chamber of Deputies and the Senate, both directly elected for four years, with membership set by electoral law in proportion to population: 312 constituency deputies plus minority-organisation seats, and 136 senators, elected by list proportional representation in 43 constituencies. The directly elected President designates a prime-ministerial candidate, and the Government needs a vote of confidence from both chambers in joint sitting.
overview.zh: 议会由众议院和参议院组成，两院均直选产生，任期四年，议员人数由选举法按人口比例确定：选区众议员 312 名另加少数民族组织议席，参议员 136 名，在 43 个选区以名单比例代表制选出。直选总统提名总理人选，政府须获得两院联席会议的信任投票。

in_force_note.en: Published in Monitorul Oficial no. 233 of 21 November 1991 and approved by the national referendum of 8 December 1991; revised by Law no. 429/2003.
in_force_note.zh: 刊登于 1991 年 11 月 21 日《官方公报》第 233 号，经 1991 年 12 月 8 日全民公决批准；经第 429/2003 号法律修订。

note.en: Text as revised in 2003, published by the Chamber of Deputies.
note.zh: 众议院公布的 2003 年修订后文本。

basis.en: 312 constituency seats under Annex 1 of Law 208/2015 (one per 73,000 inhabitants), plus one seat for each national-minority organisation that qualifies under Art. 56; the total therefore varies by election
basis.zh: 依第 208/2015 号法律附件 1 设 312 个选区议席（每 73,000 名居民一名），另为符合第 56 条的每个少数民族组织各设一席；因此总数随选举而变

label.en: Universal, equal, direct, secret and free suffrage under the electoral law
label.zh: 依选举法普遍、平等、直接、秘密、自由选举

powers.en: First-notified chamber for treaty ratification and the organic laws listed in Art. 75(1); for other bills it is the decision-making chamber.
powers.zh: 对条约批准及第 75 条第 1 款所列组织法为首先受理院；对其他法案为决定院。

basis.en: 136 senators under Annex 1 of Law 208/2015 (one per 168,000 inhabitants, at least 2 per constituency); 2015 text, Annex 1 not validly amended according to the act record
basis.zh: 依第 208/2015 号法律附件 1 设 136 名参议员（每 168,000 名居民一名，每个选区至少 2 名）；依据 2015 年文本，法规档案显示附件 1 未经有效修正

label.en: Universal, equal, direct, secret and free suffrage under the electoral law
label.zh: 依选举法普遍、平等、直接、秘密、自由选举

powers.en: First-notified chamber for bills not reserved to the Chamber of Deputies; the other chamber then decides definitively (Art. 75).
powers.zh: 对未保留给众议院的法案为首先受理院，随后由另一院作出最终决定（第 75 条）。

note.en: Both chambers are elected on the same basis and term; they differ by subject-matter competence, not by a hierarchy of override.
note.zh: 两院以相同方式选举、任期相同；区别在于事项管辖权，而非推翻关系。

label.en: Direct election; a majority of registered electors in the first ballot, otherwise a second ballot between the two leading candidates
label.zh: 直接选举；首轮须获登记选民过半数，否则在得票前两名之间举行第二轮

term_limit.en: At most two terms, which may be consecutive

label.en: Designated by the President after consultations; the Government is appointed on the basis of Parliament's vote of confidence
label.zh: 总统经磋商后提名；政府依议会信任投票任命

label.en: Republic
label.zh: 共和国

label.en: Unitary and indivisible national state
label.zh: 统一、不可分割的民族国家

label.en: Semi-presidential republic
label.zh: 半总统共和制

detail.en: A directly elected President designates the Prime Minister and may dissolve Parliament in limited cases; the Government depends on Parliament's confidence and can be censured in joint sitting. ‘Semi-presidential’ is the comparative-literature label; the Constitution does not use it.
detail.zh: 直选总统提名总理，并可在有限情形下解散议会；政府依赖议会信任，可在联席会议上被提出不信任案。“半总统制”为比较政治学用语，宪法本身未使用。

label.en: Bicameral: Chamber of Deputies and Senate
label.zh: 两院制：众议院与参议院

detail.en: Both chambers are directly elected; bills go first to the chamber competent for the subject, the other then decides (Art. 75).
detail.zh: 两院均直选；法案先送交有管辖权的一院，再由另一院决定（第 75 条）。

label.en: Direct popular vote, two ballots if needed
label.zh: 选民直选，必要时两轮

label.en: 5 years; at most two terms
label.zh: 五年；至多两届

label.en: President designates a candidate; joint sitting grants confidence; President appoints the Government
label.zh: 总统提名人选；两院联席会议给予信任；总统任命政府

detail.en: The President consults the party with an absolute majority or, failing one, all parliamentary parties. The candidate has ten days to seek confidence on the programme and complete cabinet list.
detail.zh: 总统与拥有绝对多数的政党磋商，若无则与所有议会政党磋商。人选须在十日内就施政纲领和完整内阁名单请求信任。

steps.en: President designates a prime-ministerial candidate after consultations
steps.zh: 总统经磋商提名总理人选

steps.en: Joint sitting of both chambers votes confidence on the programme and list
steps.zh: 两院联席会议就纲领与名单进行信任投票

label.en: Required: majority of deputies and senators in joint sitting
label.zh: 须获两院联席会议全体众议员和参议员过半数

label.en: Motion of censure by one quarter of all members; majority of deputies and senators in joint sitting
label.zh: 四分之一议员提出不信任案；两院联席会议全体议员过半数通过

detail.en: Debated three days after presentation. The Government may also assume responsibility on a programme or bill, which passes unless a censure motion is carried (Art. 114).
detail.zh: 提出三日后辩论。政府亦可就纲领或法案承担责任，除非不信任案通过，否则视为通过（第 114 条）。

label.en: Government may assume responsibility before both chambers (Art. 114)
label.zh: 政府可在两院前承担责任（第 114 条）

label.en: Only if no confidence vote within 60 days and after at least two rejected investiture requests
label.zh: 仅在 60 日内未获信任且至少两次组阁请求被否决后

detail.en: Once per year at most; not in the last six months of the President's term or during mobilisation, war, siege or emergency.
detail.zh: 每年至多一次；总统任期最后六个月及动员、战争、戒严或紧急状态期间不得解散。

label.en: President may return a law once for reconsideration
label.zh: 总统可将法律退回复议一次

detail.en: After reconsideration (or a Constitutional Court decision confirming constitutionality) the law must be promulgated within ten days.
detail.zh: 复议后（或宪法法院确认合宪后）须在十日内公布。

label.en: First-notified and decision-making chambers divided by subject matter
label.zh: 按事项划分首先受理院和决定院

detail.en: The first-notified chamber has 45 days (60 for codes); silence counts as adoption.
detail.zh: 首先受理院审议期限为 45 日（法典为 60 日），逾期视为通过。

label.en: Constitutional Court (Curtea Constituțională), nine judges for nine years
label.zh: 宪法法院（Curtea Constituțională），九名法官，任期九年

label.en: 4 years (both chambers)
label.zh: 四年（两院）

label.en: List PR in 43 constituencies with national pooling of remainders; 5% threshold (alliances up to 10%); minority-organisation seats
label.zh: 43 个选区的名单比例代表制，剩余票全国汇总；门槛 5%（联盟最高 10%）；另设少数民族组织议席

detail.en: 312 deputies and 136 senators in the constituencies, plus a variable number of minority-organisation deputies. Read in the 2015 text sent for promulgation; the Chamber of Deputies’ act record lists no later amendment to Arts. 4, 5(1)–(6), 56 or 94, or to Annex 1 other than Emergency Ordinance 26/2020, which the Constitutional Court found unconstitutional (Decision 150/2020). The consolidated text was not read.
detail.zh: 选区议席为众议员 312 名、参议员 136 名，另加数量不定的少数民族组织众议员。依据 2015 年送交颁布的文本阅读；众议院法规档案未列出对第 4 条、第 5 条第 1–6 款、第 56 条、第 94 条或附件 1 的后续修正，唯一例外是第 26/2020 号紧急法令，宪法法院已裁定其违宪（第 150/2020 号裁决）。合并文本未阅读。

summary.en: List proportional representation in 43 constituencies, allocated in two stages (constituency quota, then national highest quotients), for both chambers
summary.zh: 两院均在 43 个选区实行名单比例代表制，分两阶段分配（选区配额，再按全国最高商数）

constituencies.en: 43 constituencies: the 41 counties, Bucharest, and one for citizens living abroad (Art. 4). Annex 1 fixes the seats per constituency: 312 deputies and 136 senators, of which 4 deputies and 2 senators abroad, from representation norms of one deputy per 73,000 and one senator per 168,000 inhabitants, with at least 4 deputies and 2 senators per constituency (Art. 5).
constituencies.zh: 43 个选区：41 个县、布加勒斯特，以及一个旅居国外公民选区（第 4 条）。附件 1 规定各选区议席：众议员 312 名、参议员 136 名，其中国外选区众议员 4 名、参议员 2 名；依据每 73,000 名居民一名众议员、每 168,000 名居民一名参议员的代表标准，每个选区至少 4 名众议员和 2 名参议员（第 5 条）。

allocation.en: Separately for each chamber: in each constituency, seats go to lists by the constituency electoral quotient (valid votes of qualifying competitors divided by the seats, Art. 94(6)); remaining votes and unallocated seats are pooled nationally and allocated by highest quotients (divisors 1, 2, 3 …), then distributed back to constituencies (Art. 94(7)–(8)). Independent candidates win a seat if they reach the constituency quotient.
allocation.zh: 两院分别计算：在每个选区，按选区选举商数（达门槛竞选者的有效票除以议席数，第 94 条第 6 款）向名单分配议席；剩余选票和未分配议席在全国汇总，按最高商数（除数 1、2、3……）分配，再分回各选区（第 94 条第 7–8 款）。独立候选人得票达到选区商数即获一席。

applies_to.en: parties, organisations and lists (nationally), or 20% of the valid votes in at least 4 constituencies
applies_to.zh: 政党、组织及名单（全国），或在至少 4 个选区获得 20% 有效票

applies_to.en: alliances: 5% plus 3% for the second member and 1% for each further member
applies_to.zh: 联盟：5%，第二个成员另加 3%，其后每个成员各加 1%

minority.en: An organisation of a national minority that wins no seat receives one Chamber of Deputies seat if it obtains at least 5% of the average number of valid votes per deputy elected nationally (Art. 56; Constitution Art. 62(2))
minority.zh: 未获议席的少数民族组织，若其全国得票达到当选一名众议员所需平均有效票数的至少 5%，即获得一个众议院议席（第 56 条；宪法第 62 条第 2 款）

electoral_systems.legal_basis: Legea nr. 208/2015 privind alegerea Senatului şi a Camerei Deputaţilor (M.Of. nr. 553/24 iul. 2015), text sent for promulgation; Constitution Art. 62

title.en: Constitution published and approved by referendum
title.zh: 宪法公布并经全民公决批准

effective_note.en: Approved by the national referendum of 8 December 1991; the entry-into-force provision was not read.
effective_note.zh: 经 1991 年 12 月 8 日全民公决批准；生效条款未阅读。

new.en: Bicameral Parliament, directly elected President, Government accountable to Parliament.
new.zh: 两院制议会、直选总统、对议会负责的政府。

title.zh: 宪法修订（第 429/2003 号法律）

effective_note.en: Law published 22 September 2003; Constitutional Court Decision no. 356/2003 published 30 September 2003. The ratifying referendum and the entry-into-force date were not read.
effective_note.zh: 法律于 2003 年 9 月 22 日公布；宪法法院第 356/2003 号决定于 2003 年 9 月 30 日公布。批准性全民公决及生效日期未阅读。

new.en: Presidential term set at five years (Art. 83(1)); legislative procedure reorganised around first-notified and decision-making chambers (Arts. 73¹, 75, former Arts. 75–76 repealed).
new.zh: 总统任期定为五年（第 83 条第 1 款）；立法程序改为首先受理院与决定院模式（第 73¹ 条、第 75 条，原第 75–76 条废止）。

changes.legal_basis: Law no. 429/2003 on the revision of the Constitution of Romania

title.en: Law 208/2015 on the election of the Senate and the Chamber of Deputies
title.zh: 关于参议院和众议院选举的第 208/2015 号法律

effective_note.en: Promulgated by Decree 660/2015 and published in Monitorul Oficial no. 553 of 24 July 2015. The law has no commencement clause, so it took effect under Constitution Art. 78 (three days after publication); the resulting date was not read in an official record.
effective_note.zh: 经第 660/2015 号法令颁布，刊载于 2015 年 7 月 24 日第 553 号《官方公报》。该法无生效条款，故依宪法第 78 条（公布后三日）生效；所得确切日期未在官方记录中读到。

previous.en: Elections under Law 35/2008, which Law 208/2015 repeals (Art. 123); its system was not read.
previous.zh: 依第 35/2008 号法律选举，第 208/2015 号法律将其废止（第 123 条）；其制度未阅读。

new.en: Closed-list proportional representation in 43 constituencies with representation norms of 73,000 inhabitants per deputy and 168,000 per senator, a 5% threshold, and national pooling of remainders.
new.zh: 43 个选区的封闭名单比例代表制，代表标准为每 73,000 名居民一名众议员、每 168,000 名居民一名参议员，门槛 5%，剩余票全国汇总。

reason.en: The Chamber of Deputies’ total depends on the minority-organisation seats won at each election, and current sitting numbers were not verified from an official page.
reason.zh: 众议院总人数取决于每次选举中少数民族组织所获议席，现任人数未经官方页面核实。

reason.en: Referendum and entry-into-force dates of the 2003 revision were not read.
reason.zh: 2003 年修订的全民公决和生效日期未阅读。
